preconditions.description: The integers n and k are within the specified bounds [1, 1000000].

preconditions.expression: len(s) == n and all(c.islower() and c.isalpha() for c in s)
preconditions.description: The input string s has length n and consists only of lowercase Latin letters.

postconditions.expression: len(stdout) == n and all(c in '01' for c in stdout)
postconditions.description: The output is a string of length n consisting only of '0' and '1' characters.

postconditions.expression: all((stdout[i-1] == '1') == is_regular(s[:i], k) for i in range(1, n+1))
postconditions.description: For each position i from 1 to n, the i-th character of the output is '1' if and only if the prefix of length i forms a regular sequence according to the definition, and '0' otherwise.
